resources.string: Standalone synthetic-file test app with its own private journal. Build 3.1 remains installed separately. MOVE and Undo are disabled; automatic organizing is inactive. Only the two documented synthetic fixtures can be copied.
Separate diagnostic application · No access to Build 3.1’s private journal
Tap Open Settings and allow access for S26 Organizer Diagnostic. If a list of apps opens, choose this test app, not S26 Download Organizer. Return here when finished; access will be checked again.
Open your phone’s Settings → Special app access → All files access, and choose S26 Organizer Diagnostic. This permission is separate from Build 3.1. Return here to check access again.
